_howto: THE MOTO LEGION SHARED EVENTS CALENDAR - single source of truth for
every site in the formation. themotolegion.com renders EVERY upcoming
event; each creator site fetches THIS file cross-origin and renders
only events whose 'who' list names them or names 'themotolegion'.
who:    array of creator keys this event belongs to. Keys:
which means the whole formation and fans out to EVERY site.
An event listing two creators shows on those two sites plus
date:   YYYY-MM-DD. The tile shows through the end of that day and
auto-hides after - nothing is ever hand-removed again.
name:   tile headline. times: the middot-separated detail line.
where:  short venue text for the right edge. url: where the tile
links (maps pin for a meetup, ticket page for a show).
aria:   optional full sentence for screen readers; generated from
Style rules apply to all copy: no long dashes, never 'just', and
spell it 'the Moto Legion', never a bare 'the Legion'.
